reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: tried: The function-local static lbool owns whether an unknown-length log drain was attempted; it starts false and persists across calls.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

aliases_escapes.analysis: tried: The bit retains no pointer, but end_logfile dereferences thisfile while interpreting it and drains the current log/input owner.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Attempt state cannot keep the current filestate live.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

callback_targets.analysis: tried: The first drain calls ierror and ch_forw_get directly; those calls can cross display/input state while this one-shot guard remains set.
callback_targets.invariant: Drain callbacks still require stable external owners.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

invalidation.analysis: tried: Once true the guard is not reset for another log stream, so it does not carry identity for the specific FD, filename or ifile it first guarded.
invalidation.invariant: A process guard is not a stream-generation identity.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

mutation_commit.analysis: tried: It is set before draining; log close and filename retirement occur later and are not committed atomically with this flag.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

release_pair.analysis: tried: end_logfile closes a still-open log FD once, sets -1 and frees/nulls namelogfile; the Boolean itself is static and never freed.
release_pair.invariant: One-shot state does not own the log descriptor.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

error_cleanup.analysis: tried: write/close failure uses the sticky log latch; this attempt bit cannot establish successful synchronization or finding closure.
error_cleanup.invariant: An attempted drain is not a successful log-write receipt.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.

signals_handoff.analysis: tried: Cleanup and signal polling run inside the drain; raw active-file/log relationships still need the owning main-loop contract.
signals_handoff.invariant: M0-MEM-001 remains recorded for drain reentry.
limitations: M0-IO-004 remains open; this guard review does not label the improved short-write handling as an unresolved observed failure.
